name: What to Do When Your Kitchen Plumbing Needs an Upgrade

step.name: Step 1
step.text: So, you're dreaming of a new kitchen, but what about the plumbing? It's a common question we hear in Berkeley and across the East Bay. The main thing is to figure out if your current setup can handle your vision. You've got to consider things like if the existing pipes need replacing, especially if they're older. It's also smart to think about whether your appliances can be moved without a major overhaul to the lines. Don't forget about proper venting, either; that's often overlooked but super important for a healthy kitchen. A solid plan starts with confirming your sink and appliance layout early on. Then, you can check how the existing supply, drain, and vent lines will align with your new design. If you need to reroute pipes or replace fixtures, it's best to sort that out before installation even begins. This early planning avoids headaches down the road. If you're looking to upgrade your kitchen plumbing, reach out to Frasheski Construction. We're here to help you get started on your kitchen remodel.
